{{Quote|The touring company for my current production&mdash;"Hearts of Empire," now at Theed's Templexus of the Dramatic Arts, seats still available&mdash;has run into a teensy problem. Our female lead, Mairlenn, had a pet voorpak, called Dotti or something. She took the little thing with her on a visit to the countryside, let it roam, and, well, those voorpaks really are a major source of protein in the ecosystem, aren't they? Mairlenn is in quite a snit. She saw the creatures that ate Dotti, and she insists that I find someone to locate and punish those beasts, I mean really punish them. Is that okay?|Radanthus Mandelatara|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Dotti''' was a pet [[Voorpak/Legends|voorpak]] belonging to the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[entertainer]] [[Mairlenn]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Dotti was eaten by a pack of beasts in the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] countrside. Angered, Mairlenn demanded that [[Radanthus Mandelatara]] find a way to 'punish' the beasts.<ref name="AED" />

{{Creature-stub}}

Dotti was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].<ref name="AED" />
